page.overview:
Who is Akoru?

Akoru was a male Human Beast-Lord of Onderon who led the Untamed during the third Galactic War. He was brother to the Sith Brutann. During Akoru's reign, he neglected the Untamed's control of the Ancient Proving Grounds, allowing the planet's noble families to take greater control of the site for use as a vacation retreat.
